title: E8 priority editing checkpoint form A
instructions: This is composition self-editing, not a standalone editing-paper task. The prompt asks how a school skill was used elsewhere and what the writer learned. Verified notes: Lila learned to divide a large task into owners and deadlines during a school exhibition; she used the method for a neighbourhood book swap; a checklist revealed that nobody had arranged labels; she reassigned that job before the event; she learned that visible responsibilities make omissions easier to repair. The flawed draft omits the final learning, begins with book-cover colours, gives the result before the method and contains one agreement error. Make all five revision decisions.

parts.prompt: Which revision has the highest priority?

options.text: Add the missing explanation of what Lila learned from applying the method.
Replace one repeated verb with a synonym.
Correct the agreement error.
Shorten the title by one word.

choice_rationales.A: The prompt explicitly requires the learning, so this is a task-level gap.
choice_rationales.B: Word variety is lower priority than task fulfilment.
choice_rationales.C: Agreement belongs to the final sentence-control pass.
choice_rationales.D: Title length does not repair the incomplete answer.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: A missing required idea must be repaired before surface polish.

parts.prompt: Which reverse outline gives the clearest route?

options.text: Book colours → result → unrelated memory → method
Neighbourhood problem → school planning skill → book-swap application → discovered omission and repair → learning
Learning → new event → book colours → result
Result → spelling correction → school exhibition → new claim

choice_rationales.A: The route starts irrelevantly and presents the result before its cause.
choice_rationales.B: Each paragraph prepares the reader for the next stage of the transfer.
choice_rationales.C: The new event and colour detail break the focus.
choice_rationales.D: A spelling correction is not a paragraph job, and the sequence is illogical.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: The method must be established before its consequence and reflection.

parts.prompt: Which sentence should be deleted as irrelevant?

options.text: I assigned an owner and deadline to each preparation job.
The unchecked label row showed that nobody had accepted that responsibility.
Several donated novels had blue or green covers.
I reassigned the label job before the event.

choice_rationales.B: This is relevant evidence of what the checklist revealed.
choice_rationales.C: Cover colours do not advance the method, result or insight.
choice_rationales.D: This records the response to the omission.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: Concrete detail should be removed when it performs no task-related job.

parts.prompt: Which reflection stays within the verified evidence?

options.text: I learned that visible responsibilities can expose an omission early enough to repair it.
I proved that every community event will succeed if it uses a checklist.
Exactly 99 per cent of organisers now prefer my system.
I learned that book swaps are always easy.

choice_rationales.A: This matches the observed omission and repair without overclaiming.
choice_rationales.B: One event cannot prove a universal guarantee.
choice_rationales.D: The notes do not establish that all book swaps are easy.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: The reflection should generalise cautiously from the actual result.

parts.prompt: After the higher-order repairs, which sentence-level correction is needed?

options.text: Change the verified result into a stronger universal claim.
Move the result before the method again.
Add another unrelated example.
Change ‘each jobs were assigned’ to ‘each job was assigned’.

choice_rationales.D: This correctly repairs number agreement in the final pass.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: Once meaning and organisation are secure, the writer can repair agreement.
